name: La Porte (United States)
description: White field charged at the centre with the city seal: a shield of stars and stripes with a torch within a green wreath, THE CITY OF LA PORTE above and the motto THE DOOR TO THE FUTURE below.
history: La Porte is a city in LaPorte County, Indiana, of which it is the county seat.

features.role: city seal within a green wreath, a shield of stars and stripes with a torch, reading THE CITY OF LA PORTE and THE DOOR TO THE FUTURE
